reviews.text: les gars pourquoi personne ne m'a dit que la palette sentait littéralement le cacao. c'est juste délicieux. sinon les fard à paupières sont plutôt chaud mais un peu neutre parfait pour le maquillage de tous les jours. le packaging est solide, très mignon, j'adore cette marque et puis juste l'odeur quoi vraiment trop trop bonne. c'est un plaisir de se maquiller.
reviews.zh: 大家，點解冇人同我講個調色盤真係有朱古力味！真係好好味。另外眼影色調偏暖，但又有少少中性，日常化妝好啱。包裝好堅固、好可愛，我好鍾意呢個品牌，而且個味真係太太太好聞。化妝變成一種享受。

reviews.text: I’ve been searching for a mint chocolate palette and this one is the perfect one. The packaging is so detailed and high quality while the eyeshadows look amazing and are so pigmented!
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一個薄荷朱古力色系嘅調色盤，呢個就係最啱嘅。包裝好精緻、質素好高，眼影睇落好靚，色素好濃！

reviews.text: purchased a while ago and i absolutely love this palette! i chose this as my first flower knows palette as its a nice neutral palette with a pop of color and i’m glad i did. the matte shades are buttery smooth and nicely pigmented, with a brush they do go on the eye somewhat light but you can build them up without any issues. the glitter toppers are absolutely beautiful, applied on their own theyre almost transparent but they shift beautifully in color and imo can be worn on their own too!
reviews.zh: 幾耐之前買嘅，我真係好鍾意呢個調色盤！我揀咗佢做我第一款 Flower Knows 調色盤，因為佢係一個好好嘅中性色盤，同時又有啲亮色點綴，我好開心自己揀咗佢。啞光眼影質地幼滑如牛油，色素都好好，用刷子塗嗰陣會有少少淡，但係可以慢慢疊色，冇咩問題。閃粉好靚，單獨塗嗰陣幾乎透明，但係會好靚咁變色，我覺得可以單獨用。

reviews.text: Me encanto tanto esta paleta, tanto sus pigmentos, colores, textura de las sombras, el espejo, y el detalle del empaque, ame cada cosa de ella, se ha vuelto una de mis marcas favoritas de maquillaje, sin duda alguna
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個調色盤，無論係色素、顏色、眼影質地、鏡子，定係包裝嘅細節，我都好愛，每樣嘢我都好喜歡。佢已經成為我最鍾意嘅化妝品牌之一，呢點冇疑問。

reviews.text: definitivamente la mejor compra que he realizado, me encanta como se difuminan estas sombras, los colores que trae la paleta y los looks que se pueden lograr con ella, además del empaque tan hermoso.
reviews.zh: 絕對係我買過最好嘅一次購買，我好鍾意呢啲眼影暈開嘅效果、調色盤入面嘅顏色，同埋可以用佢做出嘅各種妝容，再加上好靚嘅包裝。

reviews.text: sognavo questa palette da quando è uscita e non sono rimasta delusa. i colori sono bellissimi e facilmente sfumabili e modulabili. gli ombretti glitterati sono luce pura e anche se i colori sono pochi si possono creare tantissimi look diversi. il packaging poi è meraviglioso.
reviews.zh: 由佢推出嗰陣我已經好想要，而家買咗，冇令我失望。顏色好靚，好易暈開同調節。閃粉眼影好似純光咁，雖然色數唔多，但係可以搭出好多唔同嘅妝容。包裝都好靚。

reviews.text: This palette is a true work of art. The Flower Knows Sweetie Bear packaging is stunning, but the contents are just as good. Shade 01 Buttery Croissant features a beautiful array of warm, neutral browns that are perfect for everyday 'latte makeup.' The mattes are buttery soft and blend effortlessly, while the shimmers add a delicate sparkle. The intricate bear embossing on the powders is so cute I almost didn't want to touch it! It’s a must-have for collectors
reviews.zh: 呢個調色盤真係一件藝術品。Flower Knows Sweetie Bear 嘅包裝令人驚艷，但入面嘅產品同樣好。01 Buttery Croissant 色號有一系列靚嘅暖色中性啡色，非常啱日常「latte 妝容」。啞光眼影質地好幼滑、好易推開，閃粉就加入咗細緻嘅閃光。粉體上面精緻嘅小熊浮雕可愛到我差啲唔捨得去掂佢！係收藏家必入手嘅一款。

reviews.text: Omg the packaging!! 😍 The eyeshadow pans look like little biscuits! It also smells amazing like caramel. I have this palette in 01 Buttery Croissant and the product itself is also amazing. The formula is smooth and buttery, and love how pigmented C-beauty eyeshadows are. This palette is very flattering on warm skin tones.
reviews.zh: 我嘅天啊，個包裝！😍 眼影格睇落好似一塊塊小餅乾！仲有好好聞嘅焦糖味。我有 01 Buttery Croissant 呢個調色盤，產品本身都好正。質地順滑如牛油，我好鍾意 C-beauty 眼影嘅色素咁濃。呢個調色盤好啱暖色皮膚，好襯。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
